# Examine

> Evidence-based analysis platform providing supplement research, AI-powered search tools, and professional nutrition resources backed by rigorous scientific methodology.

Examine is a Toronto-based organization dedicated to translating nutrition science research into accessible, unbiased information for health professionals and consumers. The platform combines expert literature reviews with AI technology to help users make informed decisions about supplements and nutrition.

## Key Topics

- Evidence-based analysis
- Supplement research
- Examine Pro
- ExamineAI
- Research Feed

## Products & Memberships

- [Examine Pro](https://examine.com/pro): Time-saving nutrition and supplement tools for health professionals.
- [ExamineAI](https://examine.com/examine-ai): AI-powered search tool trained on curated scientific research for supplements.
- [Compare Memberships](https://examine.com/membership): Membership comparison page for Examine Pro and Examine+ subscription plans.
- [Research Feed](https://examine.com/research-feed): Monthly research summaries across 26 health categories from expert analysis.
